title: Converge Ollama residue in sibling provisions and registries after executed B154 retirement
summary: Amendment b154-ollama-retirement-20261002 executed at rev 235 and retired B154 outright: Ollama holds no active authority, the teacher-distillation lane is decommissioned, and no module may start, probe, lazy-activate, route to or depend on an Ollama instance. Implementation removal has landed (native/ollama_service deleted and pinned file-not-exists, TeacherCollect.cs deleted, --teacher-collect is a fail-closed TEACHER_LANE_RETIRED stub, teacher-distillation.json disabled-retired, backend dependency entry removed). Sibling provisions and registries still grant or describe Ollama authority: B155 enumerates 'the local model and Ollama' plus teacher distillation as on-demand modules, B25 lists OLLAMA in the no-global-fixed-criticality set, A130 maps objectives to the 'teacher-distillation pipeline', C32 and P113 grant Ollama a C-drive install exception, formal_rule_registry row FR-OLLAMA-ON-DEMAND (controlling provision B154) still verifies active, module_capability_registry row 'ollama' still shows runtime_state=active, and codex metadata still carries the ollama demand/location keys. This request converges those rows to the executed retirement: active clauses drop Ollama/teacher-distillation grants and registry/metadata residue is marked retired. Historical tables that record observations (local_model_registry/semantic_model_registry OLLAMA_LOCAL rows, OLLAMA_* fault-code directory vocabulary, test_flow_fault_links) are left as read-only history per the retired article's own text.
origin: implementation follow-through of executed amendment b154-ollama-retirement-20261002 (rev 235): the retirement request itself listed sibling provisions still naming Ollama/teacher-distillation (B155 enumeration, A130, B25, C32) as a separate convergence item

problem.summary: B154 is retired with FORBID:ollama-service-activation-or-start|teacher-distillation-via-external-model-service|..., but live sibling provisions still grant Ollama on-demand activation (B155), name it in the criticality clause (B25), map objectives to the teacher-distillation pipeline (A130), and grant it a C-drive install exception (C32 rule+exception, P113 statement). Active registry/metadata rows (FR-OLLAMA-ON-DEMAND, module_capability_registry 'ollama', metadata ollama_local_model_demand / ollama_runtime_download_storage_root / location-exception keys) still describe the retired lane as operative.
problem.scope: codex-text and registry convergence only; no file, binary or implementation change

changes.proposed:
The main system keeps only a minimal resident core (IPC/command routing, governance and permission gates, launcher and runtime state, backend gateway and request registry, bounded maintenance health monitoring); every other module and service starts on demand: the full RAG/CAG/DAG pipeline, the native local model, independent tools, embeddings/reranker, the native self-distillation lane, indexing and offline maintenance. Activation is governed lazy activation with a readiness wait and idle unload; failures are fail-closed and reported as degraded; there is no pre-warm, no silent restart and no silent fallback to an unauthorised path. Capability state stays separate from run state so the UI shows not-started rather than failed; activation counts, cold-start latency, readiness waits and unload counts enter the performance baseline.
Existing lazy implementations (lazy RAG/CAG construction, on-demand independent tools and the model activation broker) are the foundation; no new sovereign or parallel lifecycle is created. The goal is lower idle power and local load: modules activate only when used and unload when idle; the idle baseline (RAM/CPU/GPU power and utilisation) is the acceptance reference and must be tracked continuously, and residency must never be traded for start-up speed.
Lazy RAG/CAG and on-demand tool/model activation already exist as implementation advantages; the explicit resident-vs-on-demand policy and its observability are not yet recorded or enforced.

PACKAGE-AUTO-DEFER:每24小時偵測一次。未具明確新增套件許可者自動標記DEFERRED_AWAITING_PERMISSION；一般新版發布未滿14日者自動標記DEFERRED_OBSERVATION_WINDOW。遞延不等於拒絕、通過或已安裝，遞延期間禁止下載、安裝、鎖定或執行；條件成熟後於下一次週期自動重新評估。重大安全或相容性事件得立即加跑受管檢查。

Integrated registered Codex contract objectives: seven operational goals (high speed, high performance, low load, automated operation, high stability, autonomous learning and upgrade); Xingcheng can chat with the user and complete tasks through governed permission and safety gates; no huge dataset is required; the model is quantifiable, distillable, accelerable, reason-capable and web-searchable. Each objective maps to an existing registered Codex contract mechanism (acceleration chapter, resource governance, automation division, convergence chapter, self-learning, L5/L6, T1-T4 tiers, maturity ladder, native self-distillation lane, C core / C++ layer / caches / quantization, governed web channel).
The objectives must be pursued through the existing sovereign structure and mechanisms; no new sovereign or parallel control system is introduced.
registered Codex contract integrated-objectives block records the mapping; the objectives themselves are program goals, not new components.
